decisions.reason: The premium raisin stollen won gold medals from the Deutsches Brotinstitut in two consecutive years, so its results exceed the aspiration level and give management no reason to search for alternatives.

The dark barley malt rye bread is the only one of the 2023 bread launches still on the market after A, C and F were pruned, which suggests it met the firm's expectations, and it fits low-cost artisanal production that a growing industry gives slack to carry.

The marzipan stollen sits within the firm's core seasonal stollen business, has kept its own page for two years and benefits from the reputation of the award-winning stollen line, so it appears satisfactory.
